selection_metric: pooled inner OOF pair macro F1
limitations: Synthetic data: not evidence of real-world accuracy.
Reviewed retrospective labels and assumed initial text.
Unseen pairs cannot be predicted; held-out unseen pairs remain in evaluation.
Grouped evaluation does not measure future temporal drift.
Confidence is uncalibrated; no escalation alert threshold is used.
grouping: exact text plus cosine connected components; event links ignored
